title: What is the parent's role during Speech Therapy sessions for their child with Autism?
metaTitle: Parental Involvement in Speech Therapy for Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the crucial role parents play in augmenting the outcomes of Speech Therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network for children with Autism.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we view parents as valuable partners in their child's therapy journey. Their participation in sessions, observations, comments on progress, as well as help in practicing strategies at home play a significant role in augmenting the outcomes of our Speech Therapy services.
